information_flow: The first call receives every common input and emits a policy_capsule carrying one complete executable policy artifact. The final call consumes that capsule together with anchor_contract and task_constraints, has no direct visibility of task, anchor_policy, candidate_hypothesis, or loop_structure, transforms the carried artifact under the visible obligations, and emits one policy.
name: Contract-Scoped Mutable Executable Baton
organization: two-call sequential lineage with upstream executable origination and one mutable policy-bearing handoff

calls.objective: Settle the supplied evidence into one complete executable policy artifact and carry that artifact in a single policy capsule.
Consume originate_executable_baton, apply transformation authority using only the visible contract and constraints, preserve one continuous executable lineage, and emit one complete policy.
